query: Starting from a W–Cu composite containing W particles or interconnected W ligaments within a Cu matrix, what single intervention could overcome phase separation and interfacial void formation, thereby improving thermal conductivity relative to the untreated composite under heat-transfer and irradiation conditions relevant to joints between W-based plasma-facing materials and Cu-based cooling components? Formulate one hypothesis that states the intervention, the proposed mechanism, the predicted comparative outcome, the applicable processing and service boundaries, supporting prior evidence, and a decisive falsification experiment.

generation.hypothesis: Applying a thin, uniform coating of Ti on the W particles or ligaments in the W-Cu composite will improve the thermal conductivity by 15% relative to the untreated composite under heat-transfer and irradiation conditions.
generation.material_initial_state: W-Cu composite containing W particles or interconnected W ligaments within a Cu matrix
generation.intervention: Deposition of a 100 nm thick Ti coating on the W particles or ligaments using magnetron sputtering at 300°C
generation.conditions: Heat-transfer conditions: 500°C, 10 MPa; Irradiation conditions: 1 MeV He ions, 10^22 ions/m²
generation.mechanism: Improved interface bonding and reduction of interfacial voids due to the Ti coating, leading to enhanced thermal conductivity
generation.boundary: Temperature: 500°C, Pressure: 10 MPa, Irradiation fluence: 10^22 ions/m²
generation.uncertainty: The actual improvement in thermal conductivity may vary depending on the uniformity of the Ti coating and the specific irradiation conditions

falsification_experiment.design: Comparative measurement of thermal conductivity in untreated and Ti-coated W-Cu composites under heat-transfer and irradiation conditions
measurements: Microstructural analysis of the Ti-W interface
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the thermal conductivity of the Ti-coated W-Cu composite is not at least 10% higher than that of the untreated composite, the hypothesis is falsified
